subject: psychic center identification
fact: Thorin, the least magically inclined member of the party, succeeds where all the spellcasters failed — correctly identifying the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition.
source_quote: Thorin, the least magically inclined member of the party, succeeds where all the spellcasters failed — correctly identifying the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition.

subject: dwarf clarification
fact: Chipgrin remarks he should have asked the dwarf first, before awkwardly clarifying to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.
source_quote: Chipgrin remarks he should have asked the dwarf first, before awkwardly clarifying to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.

subject: bone die origin
fact: The bone die was won off a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh, claimed to be carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie — a die with a memory for the truth.
source_quote: The old mule swore it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, said it had a memory for the truth. I thought he was just trying to cover his losses.

subject: glabbagool transformation
fact: Glabbagool briefly became a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, a single vast mind connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike, and told them in his gentle and earnest way that the world was fine and there was no need to kill anyone.
source_quote: Glabbagool briefly became a bridge between every ooze in the cavern, a single vast mind connecting jellies, puddings, and cubes alike. He told them, in his gentle and earnest way, that the world was fine, that everyone could get along, and that there was really no need to kill anyone.

subject: jimjar divine inspection
fact: Zalthir uses a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovers he possesses divine-level immunities and resistances — immune to poison and psychic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, shrugs off radiant energy and mundane weapons — a profile matching an angel or deity.
source_quote: Zalthir uses a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovers he possesses divine-level immunities and resistances. Jimjar notices, winks, and vanishes into thin air — hinting the party will meet again.

subject: zuggtmoy's subtle threat
fact: Jimjar remarks that Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister — Zuggtmoy — prefers to move in while you're sleeping.
source_quote: Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister, she prefers to move in while you're sleeping.

subject: voucher of the varmint
fact: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, he called it, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.

subject: jimjar vanishing
fact: Jimjar noticed Zalthir's scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: mysterious puffball mushroom
fact: A pale white puffball mushroom grew at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse — a sign of Zuggtmoy's quiet, creeping presence.
source_quote: Jimjar pointed to a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse.
